script.title: ಜಟಾಯುವನ್ನು ಸೂರ್ಯನಿಂದ ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಅಣ್ಣ ಸಂಪಾತಿ
sentences: ಸೀತಾಮಾತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ರಾವಣನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಮುದಿ ಹದ್ದು ಅಡ್ಡ ಬಂತು.
ಹೊಸ ರಾಮಾಯಣ ಸಿನಿಮಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಜಟಾಯು ಇವರೇ.
ರಾಮಾಯಣದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಜಟಾಯು ದಶರಥ ಮಹಾರಾಜರ ಹಳೆಯ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತ.
ಚಿಕ್ಕವರಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅಣ್ಣ ಸಂಪಾತಿ ಜೊತೆ ಪಣ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಕಡೆ ಹಾರಿದ್ದರು.
ಜಟಾಯುವಿನ ರೆಕ್ಕೆ ಸುಡತೊಡಗಿದಾಗ, ಸಂಪಾತಿ ತನ್ನ ರೆಕ್ಕೆ ಅಡ್ಡ ಹಿಡಿದು ತಾನೇ ಸುಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡ.
ವಯಸ್ಸಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೀತೆಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಲು ಹೋರಾಡಿದಾಗ, ರಾವಣ ಜಟಾಯುವಿನ ರೆಕ್ಕೆ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದ.
ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಾ ಬಂದ ರಾಮ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣರಿಗೆ ರಾವಣ ದಕ್ಷಿಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಬಿಟ್ಟರು.
ಆದರೆ ಅಣ್ಣ ಸಂಪಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಜಟಾಯು ಮತ್ತೆ ಯಾವತ್ತೂ ನೋಡಲೇ ಇಲ್ಲ.
scenes: Extreme close-up of the old vulture Jatayu's fierce face, jewelled crown, eyes burning with courage, wings flaring as he blocks Ravana's flying chariot, stormy sky.
The old crowned vulture Jatayu perched on a rocky peak in a deep forest, wise noble expression, epic golden light, wide shot.
Jatayu, the old crowned vulture, with King Dasharatha in royal robes, both smiling warmly as old friends in a forest clearing, soft morning light, medium shot.
Young Jatayu and his elder brother Sampati, two crowned vultures, racing upward toward a blazing sun, excited faces, clouds far below, brilliant light, wide shot.
Sampati spreading his great wings over his brother Jatayu to shield him from the scorching sun, Sampati's feathers smoking, his face pained but loving, blinding golden light.
The old vulture Jatayu fighting the ten-headed Ravana in his golden flying chariot as Sita cries out, Ravana swinging a sword at Jatayu's wings, stormy sky, dynamic wide shot.
Rama and Lakshmana kneeling beside the dying old vulture Jatayu on the forest floor, Jatayu pointing south with his wing, Rama's face full of grief, evening light.
Rama, with bow set aside, performing funeral rites for Jatayu at a riverside pyre, Lakshmana beside him, faces solemn and loving, smoke rising into a sunset sky, wide shot.
Sampati, the elder crowned vulture with burnt wings, alone on a distant seaside cliff gazing toward the horizon, wistful and lonely, soft dusk light, wide shot.
script.description:
ರಾಮಾಯಣದ ಜಟಾಯು ಮತ್ತು ಅಣ್ಣ ಸಂಪಾತಿಯ ಕಥೆ.
ಸೂರ್ಯನಿಂದ ರಾವಣನವರೆಗೆ ಎರಡು ಜೋಡಿ ರೆಕ್ಕೆಗಳ ಕಥೆ.
visuals: Jatayu Ravana painting Raja Ravi Varma
claims_en: In the Ramayana, the old vulture Jatayu tried to stop Ravana as he abducted Sita.
Jatayu appears in the 2026 film Ramayana: Part 1.
According to the Ramayana, Jatayu was an old friend of King Dasharatha.
In their youth, Jatayu and his elder brother Sampati flew towards the Sun under a wager.
When Jatayu's wings began to scorch, Sampati shielded him with his own wings and had them burnt.
When the old Jatayu fought to rescue Sita, Ravana clipped his wings.
Jatayu told Rama and Lakshmana, who were searching for Sita, that Ravana had headed south, then died.
Jatayu never met his brother Sampati again.
